_comment: MA3 Visualization Tab Feedback Messages - Instructors can edit these
BIN_MIN_WRONG: Your Bin Min (E22) is not the smallest difference. Use =MIN(B12:B61) to find it from the 50 differences.
BIN_MIN_MISSING: Your Bin Min (E22) is missing. Enter =MIN(B12:B61) to find the smallest of the 50 differences.
BIN_MAX_WRONG: Your Bin Max (E23) is not the largest difference. Use =MAX(B12:B61) to find it from the 50 differences.
BIN_MAX_MISSING: Your Bin Max (E23) is missing. Enter =MAX(B12:B61) to find the largest of the 50 differences.
BIN_WIDTH_WRONG: Your Bin Width (E24) is not right. It should be (Max - Min) divided by the 11 bins: =(E23-E22)/11. The parentheses matter, so the subtraction happens first.
BIN_WIDTH_MISSING: Your Bin Width (E24) is missing. Enter =(E23-E22)/11 to split the range into 11 equal bins.
FREQ_LOWER_OK: Your Lower Limit in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_LOWER_WRONG: Your Lower Limit in {cell} is not right. The first row should equal the Bin Min (=E22 in D28), and each row after that should equal the Upper Limit just above it (=E28 in D29).
FREQ_LOWER_MISSING: Your Lower Limit in {cell} is missing. Use =E22 in D28, then the Upper Limit from the row above in each row after (=E28 in D29).
FREQ_UPPER_OK: Your Upper Limit in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_UPPER_WRONG: Your Upper Limit in {cell} is not right. It should be that row's Lower Limit plus the Bin Width, e.g. =D28+$E$24 in E28, then fill down.
FREQ_UPPER_MISSING: Your Upper Limit in {cell} is missing. Enter that row's Lower Limit plus the Bin Width, e.g. =D28+$E$24 in E28, then fill down.
FREQ_TITLE_OK: Your Title of Bin in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_TITLE_WRONG: Your Title of Bin in {cell} is not the bin's midpoint. Average that row's two limits, e.g. =(D28+E28)/2 in F28.
FREQ_TITLE_MISSING: Your Title of Bin in {cell} is missing. Enter the bin's midpoint, e.g. =(D28+E28)/2 in F28, then fill down.
FREQ_COUNT_WRONG: Your Frequency in {cell} is not counting the values in that bin. Compare the data against that row's limits, e.g. =COUNTIFS($B$12:$B$61,">="&D28,$B$12:$B$61,"<"&E28) in G28, then fill down.
FREQ_COUNT_MISSING: Your Frequency in {cell} is missing. Count the values in that bin with =COUNTIFS($B$12:$B$61,">="&D28,$B$12:$B$61,"<"&E28) in G28, then fill down.
FREQ_REL_OK: Your Relative Frequency in {cell} is correct.
FREQ_REL_WRONG: Your Relative Frequency in {cell} should divide that row's frequency by a fixed total, e.g. =G28/SUM(G$28:G$38) or =G28/50 in H28. The $ signs keep the total from shifting when you fill down.
FREQ_REL_MISSING: Your Relative Frequency in {cell} is missing. Divide that row's frequency by the fixed total, e.g. =G28/SUM(G$28:G$38) in H28, then fill down.
HIST_MISSING: No histogram was found on the Visualization tab. Insert a column chart of your Frequency column (G28:G38) with the Title of Bin column (F28:F38) as its labels.
HIST_FOUND: A column chart is present on the Visualization tab.
HIST_WRONG_TYPE: Your chart is not a column (bar) chart. Make the histogram as a column chart so each bin is a bar.
HIST_DATA_OK: Your chart's data correctly comes from the Frequency column.
HIST_DATA_WRONG: Your chart is not plotting the Frequency column. Edit its data (Select Data) so the values come from G28:G38.
HIST_DATA_MISSING: Your chart's data range could not be read. Make sure its values come from the Frequency column (G28:G38) using Select Data.
HIST_LABELS_OK: Your chart's category labels correctly come from the Title of Bin column.
HIST_LABELS_WRONG: Your chart's horizontal axis labels are not the bin midpoints. In Select Data, set the axis labels to the Title of Bin column (F28:F38).
HIST_LABELS_MISSING: Your chart is missing its horizontal axis labels. In Select Data, set them to the Title of Bin column (F28:F38).
HIST_TITLE_MISSING: Your chart is missing a title. Add one that says what the histogram shows, e.g. 'Change in Scores'.
HIST_XAXIS_WRONG: Your X-axis title ("{title}") does not describe the data. Name what the bins show, e.g. 'Change in Scores' ('Frequency' belongs on the Y-axis).
HIST_XAXIS_MISSING: Your X-axis is missing a title. Name the data it shows, e.g. 'Change in Scores'.
HIST_YAXIS_MISSING: Your Y-axis is missing a title. Label it 'Frequency' (or 'Number of Students').
VIS_FORMAT_CELL_WRONG: Some cells are not formatted as required: {cell}. Fix the rest of that range with Home > Number Format.
HIST_GAP_OK: Your chart's gap width is 0%, which is correct for a histogram.
HIST_GAP_WRONG: Your chart's bars have gaps between them, so it reads as a bar chart, not a histogram. Right-click a bar, choose Format Data Series, and set Gap Width to 0%.
HIST_TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: Your chart title ("{title}") is a placeholder, not a real title. Replace it with a real title that describes the data, e.g. 'Change in Scores'.
HIST_CAPPED: Because your chart does not plot the Frequency data, it can't count as a histogram yet, so this part is capped at 2 of 6 points. Fix the chart's data first.
FREQ_COUNT_UNDERCOUNT: Instructor check (no points deducted): the frequencies add up to {counted} of the {total} data values. This can be normal, since it often comes from the bin width or limits, which are graded separately. Please verify the bin width, limits, and boundary operators by eye.
